citation.authors: Kaufman BP, Guttman-Yassky E, Alexis AF

cited_by.title: Eczema on dark skin (atopic eczema, including babies)

record.population: Literature on atopic dermatitis in non-White groups
record.finding: Atopic dermatitis occurs more often in Asian and Black people than in White people, studies are mostly in people of European ancestry, and the clinical features in non-White groups are underappreciated. The abstract does not list the features.
